izzyondroid:be.cuypers_ghys.gaai.description:
The goal of this app is to control the Nexxtender Home and Nexxtender Mobile charger without requiring the Android Nexxtmove app. The Android Nexxtmove app is the official app for controlling the Nexxtender chargers and for syncing billing information to the Nexxtmove.me website for refunding. If you no longer have a valid username and password for the Nexxtmove app, using Gaai is an option.
 Features: 
 Only requires to install Gaai.
 No additional hardware required.
 No www.Nexxtmove.me account required.
 Connects over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to the Nexxtender Home or Nexxtender Mobile.
 Finds and connects to the device based on its PN and SN. No MAC required.
 Shows real time data from the Nexxtender Home or Nexxtender Mobile: device information, charging status, current, power consumption, ...
 Allows to control the Nexxtender Home: start and stop the charger in ECO or MAX mode, sync the time with the mobile phone.
 Allows to configure the Nexxtender Home: default charging mode, max grid and max device current, off-peak hours.
 Management of badges (add, delete).

izzyondroid:eu.darken.myperm.name: Permission Pilot
izzyondroid:eu.darken.myperm.description:
Permission Pilot is a new kind of app to help you review apps and their permissions.
 With each Android update permissions are getting more complex. Android showing permissions in various different locations, doesn't make it easier to review them:
 App Info page
 Special Access
 Permissions Manager
 and more...
 Permission Pilot lists all permissions in a single location, giving you a bird's eye view of app permissions.
 Two perspectives are available: You can either view all permissions an app requests, or view all apps that request a permission.
 Apps tab All installed apps, including system apps and work profile apps. Clicking on any app will list all permissions that the app has requested, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access, along with their status. This will also include internet permissions, SharedUserID status!
 Permissions tab All permissions that exist on your device, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access. Permissions are pre-grouped for easier navigation, e.g. Contacts, Microphone, Camera, etc. Clicking on a permission shows all the apps that request access to that permission.
 Apps and permissions can be searched using free-text, sorted and filtered by different criteria.
 Overview A summary dashboard showing app counts by category — privacy, security, install source, and more. Each category row navigates directly to a filtered app list.
 Permission Watcher Get notified when an app update adds new permissions or changes existing ones. Permission Watcher checks your apps after each update and creates a report if anything changed.
 Data Export Export app or permission data in Markdown, CSV, or JSON.
 Manifest Viewer Browse raw app manifests with searchable, categorized sections. See which apps can discover other installed apps.

fdroid:app.pwhs.blockads.description:
Tired of intrusive ads slowing down your phone?
BlockAds blocks ads across all your apps and browsers with just one tap — no root required.
 KEY FEATURES 
- System-Wide Ad Blocking: Smart DNS-based filtering for every app and browser. No root access required.
- Privacy Protection: Blocks trackers and spyware. Zero data collection — everything stays locally on your device.
- App Firewall & Profiles: Block internet access for specific apps (Wi-Fi/Mobile). Switch instantly between Default, Strict, Family, and Gaming profiles.
- Parental Controls: Enforce SafeSearch (Google/Bing) and YouTube Restricted Mode via Family-safe DNS providers.
- Detailed Statistics: View real-time blocked ad counters, 24-hour activity charts, and detailed DNS query logs.
- Fully Customizable: Add custom filter lists via URL (ABPVN, AdGuard, EasyList, etc.), create allow/block rules, and use custom DoH/DoT encrypted DNS.
- Modern UI: Material 3 design built with Jetpack Compose. Features Dark/Light themes, custom accent colors, Quick Settings tile, and Home screen widgets.
- Backup & Restore: Export your configuration to JSON and easily import it on a new device.
- Battery & Data Friendly: Minimal performance impact. Filters only DNS traffic, reducing unnecessary ad data downloads.
 HOW TO USE 
- Open BlockAds.
- Tap the power button and allow the VPN connection.
- Enjoy an ad-free internet experience! (You can also toggle protection via Quick Settings tile or widget).
 FAQ 
- Is BlockAds safe? 
Yes. BlockAds only filters DNS queries locally. No personal data is intercepted or transmitted to external servers.
- Why does it need VPN permission? 
It creates a local VPN tunnel on your device to route and filter DNS requests on-device. It is not a remote VPN service.
- Does it work with all apps? 
Yes, it works system-wide. You can also whitelist specific apps or use the firewall feature to manage access.
- Is it really free? 
Yes! BlockAds is 100% free, open-source, and contains no in-app purchases or ads.
- Will it slow down my internet? 
No. DNS filtering is extremely lightweight. It actually speeds up your browsing and saves battery by preventing ads from loading.
BlockAds is free, open source, and built with privacy in mind. Download now and take back control of your Android experience!

fdroid:com.covertwogames.dozeoff.foss.name: DozeOff
fdroid:com.covertwogames.dozeoff.foss.summary: Fix delayed notifications. Stop Android Doze from holding back your alerts.
fdroid:com.covertwogames.dozeoff.foss.description:
Are your notifications arriving late, or not at all? You're not alone.
Android uses a system called Doze to save battery by putting your phone to sleep when you're not using it. The problem is that Doze also holds back notifications. Messages, emails, smart home and security camera alerts, and delivery updates can all sit waiting until you next pick up your phone.
DozeOff fixes that, and it gives you two ways to do it.
MAX MODE
Max stops your device entering Doze sleep in the first place. It does the best job of getting notifications from all your apps through on time.
The trade-off is that some devices will show a small alarm icon in the status bar, and may show a time on your lock screen. You will never hear an alarm. Whether the icon appears depends entirely on your phone, and many devices never show it at all. It isn't something DozeOff can turn off.
BALANCED MODE
Balanced lets your device sleep normally, then briefly wakes it at an interval you choose. Each wake pulls your phone out of Doze for long enough for pending notifications from every app to come through.
Nothing appears in your status bar or on your lock screen. The trade-off is timing: a notification arriving just after a wake waits for the next one.
Max is the default. Switch to Balanced any time from the home screen.
ALSO INCLUDED
* Pauses automatically during Do Not Disturb and Bedtime Mode, so it never interferes with your sleep settings
* Setup guidance for Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, OnePlus, Oppo, Vivo, ASUS, Nokia and other manufacturers with aggressive battery management
* Adjustable wake interval in Balanced mode
* Simple one-time setup, then it runs quietly in the background
* Survives reboots and app updates
GOOD FOR
* Messaging apps
* Smart home and security camera alerts
* Email and calendar reminders
* Delivery and rideshare tracking
* Anything where a late notification is a problem
PRIVACY
This build requests no network permissions at all. DozeOff cannot make a network connection, because it has no reason to. No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no account.

apple-macos:6798778906.description:
A clean, practical workout timer for anyone who trains.
Intervals, rounds and rest — set in seconds, and big enough to read from across the room. Ready-made timers for boxing, MMA, HIIT and yoga. Hundreds of workouts already written out. A log that fills itself.
No ads. No account.
EIGHT TIMERS
FOR TIME: counts up, with an optional time cap.
INTERVAL: work and rest, in as many sets as you like.
EMOM: every minute on the minute, with a movement for each minute.
AMRAP: as many rounds as possible, counting down.
TABATA: 20 seconds on, 10 off, 8 rounds, all adjustable.
DEATH BY: one more rep every minute, until you can't.
FIGHT GONE BAD: stations, work and rest, set by set.
STOPWATCH: a plain clock, counting up.
BUILD YOUR OWN, AND KEEP IT
Every timer has its own page. Set the rounds, the work and the rest, name the movements, and press START. Save the ones you come back to and they are waiting on the home screen — and on your watch.
READY-MADE, BY SPORT
Boxing and MMA rounds on the bell. HIIT and Tabata ratios. Yoga holds with the transitions between them. Open one and press play; there is nothing to set up.
THE WORKOUTS, WRITTEN OUT
Sixty classic benchmarks — The Girls and The Heroes, from Fran and Cindy to Murph — with their time caps and movements already in. Thirty more for Halloween and twenty set on South Beach. Pick one and run it.
BUILT TO BE READ ACROSS THE ROOM
The screen fills with the time, the phase and the movement by name, inside a glowing aura that changes colour as work turns to rest. Light or dark, whichever you prefer. Turn the phone on its side and it splits in two: the clock on one half, the round on the other.
CUES YOU CAN HEAR
Beeps on 3-2-1 into every interval, a long tone into work, a lower one into rest, and a triple at the end. They mix with your music instead of turning it down, and they keep going when the screen locks — on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
A LOG THAT FILLS ITSELF
Every workout you finish lands in your log, on a month calendar. Nothing to write down, nothing scored, no streak to keep up. Swipe a row to tick it off or delete it. Your history syncs through your own iCloud, and finished workouts can be saved to Apple Health.
ON EVERY SCREEN YOU OWN
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, with the same timers and the same log on each. Connect a TV by cable or AirPlay and the clock fills the big screen while your phone keeps the controls.
PRIVACY
No ads and no tracking. Anonymous usage statistics show us which timers get used, and they cannot identify you. Your workout history stays in your own iCloud, which we cannot read.
EVERYTHING INCLUDED
Every timer, every workout, the log, iCloud sync and Apple Health are included. There is an optional tip in Settings, and it unlocks nothing.

- A minimal layout that’s easy to read
- Seamless integration with Apple Calendar

Key features
[Full Apple Calendar integration]
Tempo lets you view and edit events from every account connected to your device’s system calendar, including iCloud, Google, and Naver. There’s no need to move your data or create a new account.
[Automatic iCloud sync]
Events added on your iPhone automatically appear on your iPad and Mac. Events sync through your connected calendar accounts, while individual event colors, date ranges, and other details set in Tempo sync through iCloud.
Add an appointment on your iPhone during your commute, then organize your schedule on your Mac at the office. Switch devices and pick up with the same events, without any extra steps.
[Monthly and weekly Home Screen widgets]
Add a large monthly calendar widget to your iPhone or iPad Home Screen. See a whole month of events at once, switch months, and add events right from the widget. Tap a date to open that day in your calendar.
[Lock Screen widgets]
Check a two-week calendar that includes today, or see upcoming events, right from your iPhone Lock Screen. Spot the days with plans or view up to three upcoming events to get a quick sense of your day without opening the app.
[Custom colors for individual events]
While the system calendar assigns colors by calendar, Tempo lets you choose a color for each event.
Use red for important meetings, yellow for family plans, and green for study time to see what matters at a glance.
[Date range highlights]
Outline multi-day periods such as time off, business trips, vacations, or exams with a visual border on your calendar. Unlike a regular event entry, this makes the entire date range easy to see at a glance.
[30-day event recovery]
Accidentally deleted an event? Don’t worry. Tempo safely keeps snapshots of deleted events for 30 days. Bring them back at any time during that period from "Restore events" in Settings.
[Notifications and quick access]
Get notified at the time you choose so you don’t miss an important appointment. Tap a notification to go straight to the event. Tempo integrates smoothly with Apple’s notification system for a simple, familiar experience.
[Event search]
Quickly find events by title. Search ignores differences in case and diacritics, so even part of a word can help you find a matching event.
What Tempo stands for
[Smooth interactions]
Every interaction should feel instant. Tempo focuses on natural, lightweight responses rather than heavy animations or complicated screen transitions.
[Minimal design]
Essential information is clear, and unnecessary elements are left out. By reducing visual clutter, Tempo helps you focus on your events.
[At home in the Apple ecosystem]
Tempo follows the design language of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. It makes natural use of Apple’s built-in calendar, notifications, widgets, iCloud, and more.
On the move or at your desk, keep your day flowing with Tempo.
Tempo. A calendar in tune with your day.

fedora-packages:bcd/bcd.description: BCD allows to denoise images rendered with Monte Carlo path tracing and provided in the form of their samples statistics (average, distribution and covariance of per-pixel color samples). BCD can run in CPU (e.g., renderfarm) or GPU (e.g., desktop) mode. It can be integrated as a library to any Monte Carlo renderer, using the provided sample accumulator to interface the Monte Carlo simulation with the BCD internals, and comes with a graphics user interface for designing interactively the denoising parameters, which can be saved in JSON format and later reused in batch. BCD has been designed for easy integration and low invasiveness in the host renderer, in a high spp context (production rendering). There are at least three ways to integrate BCD in a rendering pipeline, by either: * Dumping all samples in a raw file, using the raw2bcd tool to generate the rendering statistics from this file and then running the BCD using the CLI tool. * Exporting the mandatory statistics from the rendering loop in EXR format and running the BCD CLI tool to obtain a denoised image. * Directly integrating the BCD library into the renderer, using the sample accumulator to post samples to BCD during the path tracing and denoising the accumulated values after rendering using the library.

firefox-addons:2642780.description:
HLS Downloader lets you easily download fragmented media files (with .ts file extension) from the internet. 
HLS or HTTP Live steam is a new media format developed by Apple Inc. It contains a master playlist with ".m3u8" file extension. First, the extension downloads the master playlist, and then within the master, it finds playlist content. Each playlist has several fragmented items. All items are displayed in the UI with a download and a remove button. When you press on the download button the extension downloads all fragmented media and merges them all to generate a single media file. 
Note #1: the UI for the extension can be opened in the toolbar popup, tab, or a separate window. Please right-click on the toolbar button to choose the appropriate context. Within the UI, there is a toggle button to turn the addon ON or OFF.
Note #2: HLS Downloader is NOT responsible for media contents that you download with this add-on. We strongly recommend that you verify the related media copyright permissions on each website before downloading any media file(s).
Note #3: to download HLS stream you gave 3 options. (1) to add a stream URL manually, please enter the desired URL with the ".m3u8" file extension in the UI. (2) as you browse the internet, this extension monitors the webpages and captures all HLS media files, and if anything found, automatically downloads the playlist and updates the badge number accordingly (only when the addon is turned ON). The third option for downloading the HLS stream is via the context-menu item. Please right-click on ".m3u8" streams and then select - Download with HLS Downloader - from the context menu.
If you have a feature request or found a bug to report, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:853338.name: New Tab Beside
firefox-addons:853338.summary: A simple extension that opens new tab or duplicates right beside the current tab. Many other browsers have "open a new tab right next to current tab" feature built in but not Firefox, and so this extension was created.
firefox-addons:853338.description:
Instructions 
 Access context menu by right-clicking on a tab or anywhere on a webpage.
 Hotkeys:
 New Tab ( Ctrl/Command+Shift+1 )
 Duplicate Tab ( Ctrl/Command+Shift+2 )
 Note 
 Due to Firefox's new extension development standards, developers can no longer modify context menu items' ordering. We know this is mildly annoying, but there's always shortcut keys. 
 UPDATE: This extension will continue to work even with Firefox's new Duplicate Tab function starts rolling out as Firefox's implementation d̶o̶e̶s̶ ̶n̶o̶t̶ ̶d̶u̶p̶l̶i̶c̶a̶t̶e̶ ̶t̶a̶b̶ ̶b̶e̶s̶i̶d̶e̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶c̶u̶r̶r̶e̶n̶t̶ ̶t̶a̶b̶ does not duplicate beside any tabs being right clicked on. 
 UPDATE v.2.2: We hear ya. New Tab function now directly accessible upon right-clicking a tab, without the hassle of having to reach a sub-menu. The Duplicate Tab function will still work by using hotkey, as Firefox has implemented this feature for some time anyway. 
 This extension has not been (and will not be) tested in Firefox Developer Edition (or any other experimental releases) as it was not our intention to develop this outside of Firefox's mainstream releases. Thank you for your understanding and for using our extension.
